Argentina Beats Cape Verde in FIFA World Cup Thriller

Lionel Messi scored his 20th World Cup goal as Argentina defeated Cape Verde 3-2 in a thrilling match that went into extra time. The tiny African nation's stunning goals shocked the World Champion, but Argentina eventually emerged victorious.
